why: Software rendering (Mesa llvmpipe through EGL), the renderer chosen for transfer cube. SPEC.md asks for one renderer for the whole project. GPU rendering is not repeatable here: two GPU runs of the 500 insertion reproduction seeds have identical trajectories on 127 seeds, and 13 benchmark and 22 strict outcomes flip, so the repeat-run gate could not hold. Mesa runs are identical on 100 of 100 seeds.

comparison_on_reproduction_seeds.note: No published per-seed insertion file exists (published_note.md), so closeness to it cannot be measured. These are agreements between our own runs. Recompute with scratch/ins_stage0_cmp.py.
